The three Functional_Components checkpoints are correctly marked as untestable since only the covers are visible, not the interior pages. The three Material_and_Context checkpoints are correctly marked as testable and present, as the glossy paper stock, dynamic character poses, and periodical format (issue numbers, DC logos) are visible. Overall, the Router's verdicts are accurate and well-reasoned.

The texture_anomaly in the Enterprise-D is supported by the Router's observation, but the severity may also be underestimated. The topology_boundary_auditor mask shows some fragmentation on the left edge of the middle comic, which the Router did not note. Overall, the Router's artifact observations are incomplete and underestimate the severity of text-related artifacts.
